findings.title: Incorrect Return Values in Context Mounted Checks
findings.description: 91 instances where 'if (!context.mounted) return null;' is used in functions with non-nullable return types like Future<bool> or bool. This violates function contracts and could cause runtime null errors.
findings.impact: Type safety violations, potential null pointer exceptions at runtime when callers expect bool but receive null

examples.analyzer_message: A value of type 'Null' can't be returned from the method '_isWithinSiteRadius' because it has a return type of 'Future<bool>'

examples.impact: Clock-in function returns null instead of false, breaking boolean logic
Form validation returns null instead of false

correction.approach: Automated script to fix return values based on function return type
correction.verification: Re-run flutter analyze and confirm 91 return_of_invalid_type errors are resolved

findings.blocking_reason: Violates Dart type safety guarantees and could cause runtime failures when boolean values are expected but null is returned
